scope: CPU prepared automorphism key switches retain balanced primary digits as signed64 and pass their words directly to the digit FFT. Arithmetic, gadget widths, key rows, spectra, approximation defaults, noise and ciphertext bytes are unchanged.
algorithm: Move existing activeBaseDecomposeSignedRows helper from prepared_gadget_rns32.hpp into common ckks.hpp without arithmetic changes. Prepared FFT autos use it directly, removing the centered polynomial, full-torus digit array and FFT low-limb copy. Corresponding signed/unsigned aliasing is permitted by C++; static_assert verifies int64_t/uint64_t correspondence. Existing full-torus FFT overload and streamed-auto path remain available.

component_benchmark.method: Complete key switches at N16384,Q93/Q56,primary4/8,secondary16 with deterministic noncryptographic rows and noncanonical random input. Legacy function preserves previous source. Warm both paths, then legacy/compact/compact/legacy with5 samples per block; compare every output coefficient outside each timer. One thread on a pinned P core and24 pinned logical threads. Single operation timings do not reproduce the outer group-team context.

unit.coverage: At full N16384,Q93/Q56,primary4/8, compare every signed digit to original centered full-torus decomposition and every FFT spectrum word; random noncanonical inputs and zero,one,minus-one,halfQ,aboveQ edge coefficients. Existing N512 independent arbitrary-precision negacyclic convolution, nonzero serial/parallel baby-table, RNS transform and bounded FFT tests pass.

retained_replays.method: Preserved previous binary SHA before rebuilding. Four sequential processes in legacy/compact/compact/legacy order, each with a warm4/4 then4/4,8/8,8/8,4/4. Four measured samples per binary and width, excluding process warmups. Same retained sparse-Tanh input,4 roots and accumulated basis,24 logical threads. No compilation, profiling or decoding overlaps evaluation. Timers exclude key loading/cache preparation, serialization, decoding and remaining square.

validation_scope: 29 saved output archives are byte-identical to the independently qualified s2c-primary8-20261017 references, including fresh input, S2C output, functional refresh and remaining-level square. Inherit seven independent integer-phase output-class proofs and earlier baseline proof lineage. Qualification includes default4/4 original functions,8/8 original and reduced functions, and sparse accumulated Tanh4/4 and8/8. No new ciphertext output classes.
memory_scope: Primary row storage shrinks7x for the tested448-bit torus. These are per-call arrays, not total process RSS or retained cache savings. The FFT copy is per active transform, not simultaneous for all rows.
limits: One CPU and one retained input. Component speedups are not whole-evaluation speedups. Only the matched replay supports whole-operation comparison; original/reduced snapshots are qualification checks. No CUDA, key regeneration, paper-equivalent parameter or security claim.
